facts.text: U3 is the LabJack U3 class of the LabJackPython package
The U3 names 20 digital I/O lines FIO0-FIO7, EIO0-EIO7 and CIO0-CIO3 (0-19)
getAIN is a convenience method that reads one analog input and returns its calibrated voltage
getTemperature reads the U3 internal temperature sensor and returns the temperature in Kelvin
configIO sends the configIO command and returns the FIOAnalog and EIOAnalog masks; with no argument it reads the current configuration
The analog and digital configuration parameters are binary-encoded 8-bit values, one bit per line; the configU3 example uses FIOAnalog = 255 and EIOAnalog = 255
setDOState writes the state of one digital I/O line (0-19) and also sets its direction to output; state 1 is high and 0 is low
getDIOState reads the state of one digital I/O line (0-19) without changing its direction
U3.reset causes a soft or hard reset; a soft reset re-initializes most variables without re-enumeration
